objective: The judgment suite (package A4.1): twenty seeded tables, each with one planted trap (a post-outcome column, a copy of the target, an identifier, a time or group split, repeated rows, a unit conversion) or a clean control, scored for leaks kept out of the model, false alarms, unsafe moves refused and citations that exist. Scripted policies only: the standard plan, the audit's own defaults as a reference, and a deliberately bad policy.
rule: Scores are evidence about these policies on these planted traps, not about any model's readiness for production.
